summary: MetLife, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the declaration of routine quarterly and semi-annual dividends on its preferred stock series (A, D, E, F). No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change is present. The filing is a standard current report announcing dividend declarations, which does not fit any special-situations category.
